diagnosis.summary: Customers cannot complete payment at checkout because the paymentFailure feature flag is set to 100%, causing payment charge requests to fail with invalid token errors.

top.root_cause: Fault-injection feature flag paymentFailure is enabled at 100%.

evidence.summary: paymentFailure flag is currently set to 100%

proposed_action.rationale: Turn off the paymentFailure feature flag to allow payment charge requests to succeed.
